description: Land Title Settlement Department -Wadurawa, Meerigama D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No.  510282
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land title registration, specifically the declaration of a determination regarding title to specific land parcels (No. 221 and 222) under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed land particulars including parcel numbers, extent, owner names, and title classifications. The content falls under "Land and property-related matters" as defined in Type 4, dealing with land registrations and property ownership determinations.
